sermon.title: Solutions to Government Problems — October 25, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer turns to solutions after teaching that nations get the governments they deserve. Christians must be strong, judge sin rightly, and set goals. Abraham didn’t only pray; he armed his servants and rescued Lot. Nothing restrains the Lord, so begin by becoming Jesus’ friend and raising righteous leaders who glory in knowing God.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
